description: The hook script for a listener port and token: bash that reads the event payload from stdin first, posts it in the background to the loopback listener with curl (the token in a double-quoted header, escaped per Character: backslash, double quote, dollar and backtick, and anything canonically equal to them, get a backslash; a Character equal to LF or CR is dropped, so CR LF is kept), and exits 0. The port is clamped to 1...65535.
function: HookInstaller.hookScriptBody(port:token:) — input {port, token}, expected the script's file lines (joined with "\n"; the final "" means it ends with a newline)
verifiedBy: DESIGN.md v1.6, v2.14; Tests/PowerUpTests/HookFixtureTests.swift testHookScriptTable compares HookInstaller.hookScriptBody byte for byte. Rust: rust/powerup-core/tests/hooks.rs hook_script_cases runs hooks::hook_script_body.
capturedAgainst: Swift 5.9.2 Foundation (Xcode 15.2) on macOS 27.2, PowerUp at 2dd77aa

cases.name: the default port and a plain token
expected: # PowerUp hook — forwards Claude Code hook events to the PowerUp app.
# Generated by PowerUp (Settings → Remote). Safe to delete: without it the
# app simply loses spoken read-back from terminal/cmux sessions.
# stdin is consumed BEFORE curl is backgrounded, so the payload can never
# be lost, and the script always exits 0 immediately — Claude is never
# delayed or blocked by PowerUp being closed, busy, or on another port.
cases.reason: The script reads stdin before backgrounding curl, posts to the loopback /event with the token header and --max-time 1, and always exits 0, so Claude is never delayed (HK-184).

cases.name: shell metacharacters in the token are escaped
expected: # PowerUp hook — forwards Claude Code hook events to the PowerUp app.
# Generated by PowerUp (Settings → Remote). Safe to delete: without it the
# app simply loses spoken read-back from terminal/cmux sessions.
# stdin is consumed BEFORE curl is backgrounded, so the payload can never
# be lost, and the script always exits 0 immediately — Claude is never
# delayed or blocked by PowerUp being closed, busy, or on another port.
cases.reason: Backslash, double quote, dollar and backtick get a backslash inside the double-quoted header, so a token can never inject shell code (HK-185).

cases.name: LF and CR in the token are dropped
expected: # PowerUp hook — forwards Claude Code hook events to the PowerUp app.
# Generated by PowerUp (Settings → Remote). Safe to delete: without it the

# stdin is consumed BEFORE curl is backgrounded, so the payload can never

cases.reason: A Character equal to LF or CR is dropped (HK-185).

cases.name: CRLF in the token is one character and is kept
expected: # PowerUp hook — forwards Claude Code hook events to the PowerUp app.
# Generated by PowerUp (Settings → Remote). Safe to delete: without it the
# app simply loses spoken read-back from terminal/cmux sessions.
# stdin is consumed BEFORE curl is backgrounded, so the payload can never
# be lost, and the script always exits 0 immediately — Claude is never
# delayed or blocked by PowerUp being closed, busy, or on another port.
cases.reason: Swift walks Characters, and CR LF is one Character equal to neither LF nor CR, so it stays (measured).

cases.name: a backslash that a combining mark follows is not escaped
expected: # PowerUp hook — forwards Claude Code hook events to the PowerUp app.
# Generated by PowerUp (Settings → Remote). Safe to delete: without it the

# stdin is consumed BEFORE curl is backgrounded, so the payload can never
# be lost, and the script always exits 0 immediately — Claude is never
# delayed or blocked by PowerUp being closed, busy, or on another port.
cases.reason: A backslash followed by U+0301 is one Character that is not a backslash.

cases.name: Greek varia counts as a backtick
expected: # PowerUp hook — forwards Claude Code hook events to the PowerUp app.
# Generated by PowerUp (Settings → Remote). Safe to delete: without it the
# app simply loses spoken read-back from terminal/cmux sessions.
# stdin is consumed BEFORE curl is backgrounded, so the payload can never
# be lost, and the script always exits 0 immediately — Claude is never
# delayed or blocked by PowerUp being closed, busy, or on another port.
cases.reason: U+1FEF GREEK VARIA is canonically equivalent to the backtick, and Character equality is canonical, so Swift escapes it.
